::: {#xp-guide-printing}
:::

::: {.contribution authors="kai-wu"}

Every September, the University resets PhD students' printing balances to RMB 2,000. Check yours at <https://myprint.xjtlu.edu.cn>. This effectively gives each PhD student almost unlimited printing. I personally like printing papers to read them. For instructions, I suggest going straight to the official documents. The files are in this project's GitHub repository ([link](https://github.com/kaiwu-astro/xp_pgrs_unofficial_guide/tree/main/fileshare)), or use the links below.

- Undergraduate IT guide (Chinese and English): <https://gitee.com/kaiwu-astro/xp_pgrs_unofficial_guide/tree/main/fileshare>

- Printing guide (English): <https://guide.xjtlu.edu.cn/ss-print/staff>

Please do not print entire books: it violates printing policy and may be investigated. Printing individual chapters is generally allowed. If you really need a whole book printed, use a Taobao printing service.

(12 October 2022, by [Kai Wu](mailto:kaiwu.astro@gmail.com))

:::
